from jinja2 import Environment
import pytest
from collections import namedtuple

def test_groupby_case_sensitivity(env):
    User = namedtuple('User', ['name'])
    users = [
        User(name="Alice"),
        User(name="bob"),
        User(name="Charlie"),
        User(name="dave")
    ]

    tmpl = env.from_string('''{% for group in users|groupby("name", case_sensitive=False) %}{{ group.grouper }}{% endfor %}''')
    assert tmpl.render(users=users) == "AlicebobCharlieDave"
